def px2w(row,col): return [0.25+row/128*0.5,(col-128)/256]
q=[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0]
r=primitives.call(name='submit_vima_action',pose0_position=px2w(85,174),pose0_rotation=q,pose1_position=px2w(85,156),pose1_rotation=q)
print(r.ok, str(r.output)[:1500])
r=primitives.call(name='inspect_vima_instances',view='top',min_pixel_count=1)
if r.ok:
    for i in r.output['instances']['top']: print(i['segmentation_id'],i['bbox_xyxy'],i['center_xy'])
